entry.name: 가드리아
entry.identity_basis: Unique Legend_Gadria body 17633; gold helmet/armor, white split skirt, bow and visible gold boots. Eight-view strides and planted/raised soles checked with a fixed torso ground projection; not another archer.
entry.direction_review: h1 back = N; h5 chest/front = S; h3 profile right = E; h7 profile left = W; all diagonal views checked.
entry.foot_review: Anatomical midpoint of two grounded feet/robe hem in breathing poses, compared against walking poses. One fixed anchor across every source file; no per-frame bbox recentering.
